name: Moldavite: Notes & Ideas
subtitle: Write, journal, connect
promotionalText: A quiet place for quick notes, daily reflections and bigger ideas. Write, connect your thoughts and keep your notes in your own Markdown files.
description:
Give your thoughts a place to grow. Moldavite brings everyday notes, daily reflections and longer writing together in a calm workspace on iPhone and iPad.

WRITE YOUR WAY
Capture a quick thought or settle into a longer note. Add headings, lists, checklists and formatting as you write.

CONNECT YOUR IDEAS
Link related notes, organize with folders and tags, and find what you need with keyword search. Keep different areas of your life in separate workspaces, called Forges.

MAKE ROOM FOR EVERY DAY
Use daily and weekly notes for journaling, plans and reflections.

KEEP YOUR NOTES YOURS
Your notes are stored as Markdown files. Start locally without creating a Moldavite account, and export your writing when you want to use it elsewhere. Protect individual notes with a passphrase using note locking.

SETTLE INTO YOUR SPACE
Choose light or dark appearance and adjust your writing preferences.

From a passing thought to a personal collection of knowledge, Moldavite helps you keep writing.
notes:
Moldavite is a local-first Markdown note app for iPhone and iPad. No app account or sign-in is required. Complete the introductory screens to open the local workspace (called a Forge), then create a note. Optional iCloud Drive uses the device owner’s Apple account; local note-taking does not require it.

Note locking uses a passphrase chosen by the reviewer. The developer cannot recover a lost passphrase. The home-screen widget opens today’s note. Desktop executable plugins, desktop calendar integrations and the desktop self-updater are not included in the iOS experience.
